method: Re-check of applied names against cataclysm_gog_r4a (functions.csv, call_graph.csv, decompiled.c) and HomeworldSDL src. low-r3/low-r2: every applied function name whose notes say confidence=low in symbols_round2.json/symbols_round3.json, plus the 2 low r2-deferred names created by B1 (51 r3 + 69 r2 = 120); body, callers and callees compared with the HW1 body or with the producer's evidence. shipselect: every function classed hw1:ShipSelect.c (r3 verified sets, symbols files) checked for a definition in Game/ShipSelect.c and against its HW1 body. call-order: for HW1 files with >=10 matched names, matched addresses sorted and compared with the .c definition order; inversions and runs of adjacent names checked by body/callers for one-slot shifts. Only changes are emitted.

proposals.name: cat_MoveReachedDestinationRadius
proposals.evidence: r4a body: TRUE when |ship->posinfo.position - *dest|^2 < r^2 (spherical twin of MoveReachedDestinationVariable 0x419d50, after MoveLeftToGo); HW1 aiuGenerateRandomVector returns a random vector

proposals.name: cat_blastSaveList
proposals.evidence: SaveLinkedListOfStuff(&0xa5e288,...); 0xa5e288 is the blast list: cat_blastCreate listAddNode(0xa5e288), cat_blastUpdateAll walks it. Caller SaveUniverse

proposals.name: cat_blastLoadList
proposals.evidence: LoadLinkedListOfStuff(&0xa5e288,...) then sets 0xa67010=1 (flag also read by cat_blastUpdateAll); 0xa5e288 = blast list of cat_blastCreate. Caller LoadUniverse
